body.statement: For every \(\eta\in\mathcal C(\mathcal O)\), where the interventional components of \(\mathcal O\) are induced by the faithful pooled selected laws \(P_{\eta,k}^{\mathrm{pool}}\), fix \(k\in[K]\) and an intervention-created observed adjacency \(uv\) with \(u,v\in A(\eta)\), meaning that \(uv\) is absent from the observational skeleton \(H\) and present in the regime-\(k\) skeleton. Over \(\mathcal C_A(\mathcal O,\eta)\), an arrowhead at \(u\) on \(uv\) is feasible if and only if \(u\in Z_k\), and a tail at \(u\) is feasible if and only if \(u\notin Z_k\) or \(\operatorname{Reach}_{A(\eta)}(u,v)=1\). Here \(u\in Z_k\) means that \(u\) is either a direct target or an indirectly affected ancestrally selected variable, not that \(u\in T_k(\eta)\). Every feasible mark is attained by a whole-family common-basal model in \(\mathcal C_A(\mathcal O,\eta)\) preserving the full pooled-law signatures on \(U_k\). Retained adjacencies \(uv\in H\) are outside this target-membership equivalence and retain any arrowheads supplied by basal directed structure, as in \(\mathrm{prop:retained\mbox{-}edge\mbox{-}sanity\mbox{-}reduction}\).
body.justification: The theorem gives the exact target-and-reachability frontier for the intervention-created selected adjacencies to which that mechanism applies.
body.gap: Dai et al., Lemmas 4--6 on pp. 6--7, give fixed-model adjacency, indicator-neighbor, and endpoint semantics; they do not prove the reverse common-basal witness construction over a fixed-\(A(\eta)\) equivalence fiber.
body.consumer: The result classifies which intervention-created selected-gene endpoints can remain biological ambiguity after selection membership is certified.

obligation.what_is_open: Promote the empty-subgraph and signature-monotone-path graphical witnesses to whole-family models in the fixed-\(A\) compatibility fiber.
obligation.obstruction: The endpoint necessity and both replacement graphs follow from the Dai formulas, but the theorem quantifies over fully specified faithful models. That last quantifier cannot be discharged while simultaneous faithful realization is open.
obligation.attempted: Derived the necessity direction and used \(B=\varnothing\) for an arrowhead specification and a simple path in \(L_{A(\eta)}\) for a tail specification. The graphical replacement lemma preserves every full-regime signature; only faithful kernel realization remains.
obligation.partial_result:
The fixed-\(A\) necessity is graphical.  For an intervention-created adjacency \(uv\) with \(u,v\in A(\eta)\), the Dai endpoint formula gives
\[
\mu(u)=\mathtt{arrow}\Longrightarrow u\in Z_k,
\qquad
\mu(u)=\mathtt{tail}\Longrightarrow
\bigl(u\notin Z_k\bigr)\ \text{or}\ u\in\operatorname{An}_{G_0}(v).
\]
If \(u\in\operatorname{An}_{G_0}(v)\), an ancestral path cannot leave and re-enter the ancestor-closed set \(A(\eta)\); every path edge lies in \(H[A(\eta)]\), and descendant closure of every \(Z_\ell\cap A(\eta)\) gives \(\sigma(x)\subseteq\sigma(y)\) along the path.  Hence \(\operatorname{Reach}_{A(\eta)}(u,v)=1\).  Conversely, the empty choice of \(B\) gives the graphical arrowhead witness when \(u\in Z_k\), and a simple \(L_{A(\eta)}\)-path from \(u\) to \(v\), used as \(B\), gives the graphical tail witness.  Such a path is acyclic and has no vertex with two incoming path edges.  The proved graphical replacement lemma preserves all regime signatures for both specifications.  Promoting these two graphical specifications to members of \(\mathcal C_A(\mathcal O,\eta)\) is exactly the unresolved simultaneous-faithful-realization step.
